text:
You're not unmotivated. You're sleep deprived.

Your brain dies past six hours. Zero focus. The phone urge. That's not laziness. That's your brain fragmenting.

Your diet finishes it. Processed food, excess sugar, excess salt make you chemically dependent on stimulation.

Sleep 7 to 8 hours every night.
Eat protein. Red meat. Vegetables. Legumes.
Cut the junk.

Two weeks and your brain rewires. You face discomfort instead of running.

Build yourself. Stop poisoning yourself.
caption:
Sleep isn't weakness, it's the foundation of a strong mind.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
